Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved playing outside in her garden. One day, she found a big worm and she picked it up. It was fine! 

Suddenly, Lily heard a voice behind her. It said, "Hello, little worm. Where are you, little worm?" It asked Lily. 

The worm said, "I am a worm. I can help you find my way home." 

Lily wanted to help the worm and he said, "I can will provide you with me with some worm." The worm took the worm and Lily thanked it
